intentions.title: Decompose the Studio god-LiveView into state-coupled seam modules (Shared, Mount, Paths, DocActions, Blocks) so the callback module stays a thin dispatcher
intentions.evidence: shared.ex moduledoc: 'Every function here was a defp on the StudioLive god-module before the handler-body extraction (Modularity gate)... behaviour-preserving'; mount.ex/paths.ex/doc_actions.ex/blocks.ex each extracted a single concern (init assigns, URL grammar, doc-action registry, block-patch catalog) with @doc false internal-seam markers.

intentions.title: Ship a continuous ProseMirror paper canvas that subsumes the legacy per-block editor without breaking it, behind a fail-toward-mainline feature flag
intentions.evidence: paper_canvas.ex: paper_canvas_enabled?/0 defaults TRUE (D7/D9 cutover), only literal '0'/'false' opt out, any typo keeps canvas on; partition_runs/1 groups blocks into maximal contiguous canvas-eligible runs (prose, divider, callout, code/diagram attr-atoms, field-* controls, sheet/embed read-only atoms, 12 fleet types, table, figure, columns/section/terminal containers, card/stage widgets) vs boundary blocks that still split; extensive lockstep comments tying Elixir partitioning to run-convert.js.

intentions.title: Grow the canvas's eligible-block surface incrementally (S3 through S10, t12a, editable-table/figure/section/terminal/card/stage) until nearly the whole document body is one editable run, while forbidding container-in-container
intentions.evidence: paper_canvas.ex module-attribute stack (@canvas_atom_types, @canvas_content_types, @canvas_attr_atom_types, @canvas_field_types, @canvas_picker_field_types, @canvas_readonly_atom_types, @canvas_fleet_types, @canvas_role_types, @canvas_table_types, @canvas_figure_types, @canvas_task_list_types, @canvas_container_types, @canvas_widget_types) each documenting a dated increment; 'V1 forbids container-in-container: a container encountered as a CHILD is carried as read-only verbatim'.

intentions.title: Enforce a WordPress-style metadata sidebar doctrine: status/slug/context/labels/relations live outside the article body, title+featured-image stay locked body blocks
intentions.evidence: paper_canvas.ex t6 section: sidebar_meta_op/2 returns {:doc_field, field, value} 'deliberately NOT a body block op'; slug_feedback/1 is a pure instant format check; visibility_label/1, paper_labels/1, paper_relations/1 pull sidebar data from doc fields/blocks without touching the article body.

intentions.title: Give every Studio surface (list, presence, sheet, graph, paper, media-explorer) consistent subscribe/unsubscribe and view-switch lifecycle so panes never leak stale PubSub topics or Presence trackers
intentions.evidence: shared.ex: ensure_list_subscription/2, ensure_presence_subscription/1, ensure_sheet_subscription/2, resub_sheet_deltas/2, resub_sheet_presence/2, subscribe_to_doc/1 all diff old vs new topic before unsubscribing/tracking; rebuild_panes/1 dispatches to setup_paper_view/setup_sheet_view/setup_graph_view/media_explorer clearing the other views first.

intentions.title: Keep the Studio URL grammar single-sourced across flat and workspace/project-scoped surfaces
intentions.evidence: paths.ex moduledoc: 'THE Studio URL builder — the single owner of the Studio path grammar'; studio_path_for/3, studio_path/4 (socket-free) mirrored by shared.ex's socket-aware studio_path/4 delegate; scoped_root/3 vs flat_root/1 as 'ONE owner each for the scoped and deliberate-flat grammars'.

intentions.title: Let plugins amend the document action bar (Publish/Unpublish/Delete/History/Export ONIX/Bokbasen) without the host hardcoding plugin-specific buttons
intentions.evidence: doc_actions.ex: resolved_doc_actions/1 builds a baseline via default_doc_actions/2 then calls Barkpark.Plugins.Registry.collect_doc_actions/1 so 'each plugin's resolve_doc_actions/2 can drop, reorder, or amend entries'; workspace_id threaded into ctx to skip per-workspace-disabled plugins.

intentions.title: Guarantee draft/publish/unpublish/bulk actions respect plugin-issued halts (e.g. cross-field validation, workflow gates) and surface partial-failure feedback to the editor
intentions.evidence: shared.ex do_autosave/2, do_unpublish/1, do_action/3, bulk_action/2 all pattern-match {:error, {:halted, reason}} distinctly from generic {:error, _} and report 'cancelled by plugin rules' counts alongside ok/err counts in bulk_action/2's flash message.
